parameters.name: $_SESSION['login']
parameters.rationale: Stores the authenticated username after successful login. Checked in security.php (line 45: isset($_SESSION['login']) && $_SESSION['login']) to enforce authentication. Displayed in UI headers. Core identity parameter.

parameters.name: $_SESSION['admin']
parameters.rationale: Stores the admin flag (0 or 1) set during login from the database 'admin' column. Used in security.php line 40 for AIM mode and represents the user's admin role.

parameters.name: $_COOKIE['security_level']
parameters.rationale: Security level cookie set after login (login.php:103-111) and on security_level_set.php (line 63). Controls which security level (low/medium/high/666) applies to vulnerability pages. The '666' value bypasses all security levels. An authorization-related parameter.
